title: Panda reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='58' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#1f2842' transform='rotate(-25 26 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='58' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#1f2842' transform='rotate(25 74 58)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='20' fill='#f2f4ff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='14' r='7' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='14' r='7' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='28' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#2a3550' transform='rotate(-15 42 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='28' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#2a3550' transform='rotate(15 58 28)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='3' fill='#f2f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='3' fill='#f2f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#3a4a70'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#3a4a70'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 41 Q50 45 55 41' stroke='#3a4a70' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='52' height='26' rx='3' fill='#e8543f'/>
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='52' height='26' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a6e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='28' y='66' width='44' height='18' rx='2' fill='#fff6df'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='32' y1='71' x2='68' y2='71' stroke='#c9b48f' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='75' x2='68' y2='75' stroke='#c9b48f' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='79' x2='56' y2='79' stroke='#c9b48f' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#1f2842'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='70' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#1f2842'/>
</svg>
